sources.facts: Four iwans around qibla-aligned courtyard, four plots with central circular pool, two western entrance minarets, two northeastern clock-side minarets, and four at the southwest iwan. Lower winter prayer hall east of the court and high domed summer hall to the southwest.

Eight minarets with a 25 to 37 metre height range, low-profile main dome quoted at 25 metres in the exterior description, 45-metre summer hall with four smaller domes in the arms, stone plinths, polychrome glaze, 60 study cells on two floors and a five metre clock housing. Consulted textual facts without drawings or photos.
Curzon’s 1892 published account describes site approach and quadrangle pool, bright tile across four tall shafts and florid capitals. Textual record only.
